additions.reason: The gate called Love (tara'a de'itkeri ahava) is the Zohar's name for the opening through which a righteous person enters the hidden good. The Torah equates it with Abraham's trait and the right side. Must be added to the dataset.

The right side (sitra di-ymina) is the sefirot column of Chesed, to which Abraham belongs. The Torah equates it with the Love gate and with the quality of the white brain. It is the structural axis of Package 1.

The white brain like silver (mocha hivara ke-kaspa) is cited from Tikkunei Zohar (Tikkun 70) and equated with the right side. It describes the cognitive/spiritual effect of the right side: the mind becomes clarified, open, white — no foreign thought can resist it. It is the culminating quality of Package 1: what the right-side / Love / Abraham path produces as its characteristic inner state.

Serpents and scorpions are the Zohar's mythic image for the forces that block sinners from accessing Torah secrets. The Torah equates them with the accusers (mekattregim) and with foreign thoughts (machashavot zarot). They are the dominant image of Package 2 — the blocking/evil cluster.

The accusers (mekattregim) are the prosecutorial-spiritual form of the same blocking force. They appear in the Zohar quote alongside serpents and scorpions and are explicitly equated with foreign thoughts in Rebbe Nachman's commentary.
additions.source_quote: כָּל הַמְקַטְרְגִים וְכָל הַנְּחָשִׁים וְעַקְרַבִּים, הַיְנוּ הַמַּחֲשָׁבוֹת זָרוֹת שֶׁמְּבַלְבְּלִין מַחֲשַׁבְתֵּהּ

additions.reason: Foreign thoughts (machashavot zarot) are Rebbe Nachman's psychological translation of the Zohar's serpents/scorpions and Talmudic accusers. They are what actually happens to a person when they try to study Torah secrets — distracting, disrupting thoughts arise. This is the most 'interior' or psychological form of the same blocking force.

The hidden good (hatov haganuz) is the concealed, day-specific divine content stored within each of the six days of creation. The Zohar teaches that each day has its own partzuf and its own hidden good, accessible only through the correct gate. This is equated with Torah secrets (razin de'orayta).

additions.reason: Secrets of Torah (razin de'orayta) is the Zohar-Aramaic expression for the hidden dimension of Torah. It is directly equated with the hidden good in Rebbe Nachman's commentary. Together with hatov haganuz, it forms the destination-content package.

analysis_notes.good_evil_mirror_check: The Torah has a clear two-way mirror structure: Package 1 (right side / love / white mind) is the structural opposite of Package 2 (accusers / serpents / foreign thoughts). Package 1 OPENS; Package 2 CLOSES. The Torah's main argument is that the right-side quality (Abraham's generosity) causes the Package 2 forces to whiten and neutralize: 'נַעֲשִׂין חִוָּרָא כְּכַסְפָּא' — they become white like silver. This is the eitza bridge between the two packages: Package 1 → neutralizes Package 2 → thereby granting access to Package 3.
